BiblicalUsage: Paul sails past Chios and comes the next day over against Samos, the ship holding its course on the far side. The word means directly opposite, facing across the water.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for over against carries no doctrine of its own; its interest is the voyage, that Paul's ship passed Samos on the far side.
